items.description: Assumption 1 states default.json is the file actually read. configPath prefers APP_CONFIG, then config/local.json when it exists, and local.json IS present in the tree — so editing default.json changes nothing at runtime. The plan's whole effect rests on a premise the loader contradicts.
Step 2 cites src/loader.ts:42; the file is 15 lines long, so the citation resolves to nothing.
